---
title: "Publications"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml

with open('data/publications.yaml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

peer_reviewed = data.get('peer_reviewed') or []
reports = data.get('reports') or []
conference_abstracts = data.get('conference_abstracts') or []
in_progress = data.get('in_progress') or []

# Peer-reviewed
print("## Peer-Reviewed Publications\n")
for pub in [p for p in peer_reviewed if p.get('status') != 'under_review']:
    authors = pub['authors'].replace('Maharjan, M.', '**Maharjan, M.**')
    vol = f", *{pub['volume']}*" if pub.get('volume') else ""
    doi_link = f" <a href='{pub['doi']}' target='_blank'>{pub['doi']}</a>" if pub.get('doi') else ""
    print(
        f"{authors} ({pub['year']}). "
        f"{pub['title']}. "
        f"*{pub['journal']}*{vol}.{doi_link}\n"
    )

# Preprints / Under Review
print("---\n")
print("## Preprints & Papers Under Review\n")
for pub in [p for p in peer_reviewed if p.get('status') == 'under_review']:
    authors = pub['authors'].replace('Maharjan, M.', '**Maharjan, M.**')
    doi_link = f" <a href='{pub['doi']}' target='_blank'>{pub['doi']}</a>" if pub.get('doi') else ""
    print(
        f"{authors} ({pub['year']}). "
        f"{pub['title']}. "
        f"*{pub['journal']}*. Under review.{doi_link}\n"
    )

# Reports
print("---\n")
print("## Research Reports & Technical Publications\n")
for rep in reports:
    authors = rep['authors'].replace('Maharjan, M.', '**Maharjan, M.**')
    url_link = f" <a href='{rep['url']}' target='_blank'>Full text</a>" if rep.get('url') else ""
    print(
        f"{authors} ({rep['year']}). "
        f"{rep['title']}. "
        f"*{rep['publisher']}*.{url_link}\n"
    )

# Conference abstracts
print("---\n")
print("## Conference Abstracts & Presentations\n")
for ab in conference_abstracts:
    authors = ab['authors'].replace('Maharjan, M.', '**Maharjan, M.**')
    doi_link = f" <a href='{ab['doi']}' target='_blank'>Abstract</a>" if ab.get('doi') else ""
    print(
        f"{authors} ({ab['year']}). "
        f"{ab['title']}. "
        f"*{ab['conference']}*, {ab['location']}.{doi_link}\n"
    )

# In progress
print("---\n")
print("## In Preparation\n")
for wip in in_progress:
    badge = " *(Systematic Review & Meta-Analysis)*" if wip.get('type') else ""
    prospero = f" PROSPERO: {wip['prospero_registration']}." if wip.get('prospero_registration') else ""
    authors = wip.get('authors', '')
    if authors:
        authors = authors.replace('Maharjan, M.', '**Maharjan, M.**') + f" ({wip['year']}). "
    journal = f" Target: *{wip['target_journal']}*." if wip.get('target_journal') else ""
    desc = f" *{wip['description']}*" if wip.get('description') else ""
    title = wip['title']
    print(
        f"{authors}"
        f"{title}.{badge}{prospero}{desc}{journal}\n"
    )
```
